-- The client says: Fired when info for a newly placed room has been recieved while in Layout Mode.
local frame = CreateFrame("Frame")
frame:RegisterEvent("HOUSING_LAYOUT_ROOM_RECEIVED")
frame:SetScript("OnEvent", function(self, event, playAddedSound)
end)
